question:
Select the Venn diagram that best represents the relationship between the following classes.

Fairies, Mythical creatures, Unicorns
solution:

• All Fairies are Mythical creatures.
 
• All Unicorns are Mythical creatures.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7be8433c79c0ee971480b8a2a3fa09cff0a5de6003c36c2b79afd2ace5d08da0.png]
